COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
19.08.2025 CRLR No. 503 of 2025
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Ms. Priya Mewari, learned counsel for the
Revisionist.
2. Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned A.G.A. assisted by 
Mr. Prabhat Kandpal, learned Brief Holder for the 
State. 
3. This criminal revision under Section 438/442 
of B.N.S.S., 2023 R/w Section 397/401 of Cr.P.C. is 
filed by the revisionist for setting-aside the judgment 
and order dated 02.06.2025 passed by learned Family 
Court/District Judge, Champawat in Misc. Criminal 
Case No.28 of 2024, titled as “Smt. Sunaina and 
Another vs. Manoj Rajpur”, whereby the learned 
Family Court/District Judge, Champawat partly 
allowed the application for maintenance under 
Section 125 of Cr.P.C. filed by opposite party no.2 
and passed an order for maintenance to the extent of 
Rs.3500/- in favour of opposite party no.2 and Rs. 
2000/- in favour of son of revisionist and opposite 
party no.2 to be paid from the date of order i.e. 
02.06.2025.
4. Heard. 
5. Admit. 
6. Issue notice to the Respondent no.2, returnable  within two weeks. Steps to be taken within one week.
7. Objections, if any, to be filed by the 
Respondents within a period of three weeks.
8. List this matter on 06.10.2025.
9. The effect and operation of the judgment and 
order dated 02.06.2025 passed by learned Family 
Court/District Judge, Champawat in Misc. Criminal 
Case No.28 of 2024, titled as “Smt. Sunaina and 
Another vs. Manoj Rajpur”, shall remain stayed till 
the next date of listing.
10. Stay Application (IA No.01 of 2025) stands
disposed of. 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 
 19.08.2025
Akash
